name: io.github.tonyyang0504/bilibili-mcp
description: Bilibili (social): me, delete, analytics_post. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BILIBILI_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: client_id of your Bilibili open-platform app (openhome.bilibili.com); also the x-bili-accesskeyid of every signed call.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BILIBILI_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The app secret (app_secret); signs every call (HMAC-SHA256) and is sent only to the refresh endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BILIBILI_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: The user's refresh_token from the OAuth2 code exchange (https://api.bilibili.com/x/account-oauth2/v1/token, scopes USER_INFO, ARC_BASE, ARC_DATA). Single-use: each refresh returns a new one that replaces it (persisted when PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR is set).
